Explanation:  
The Predicted Answer states that Edmund Fitzgerald was still alive when the SS Edmund Fitzgerald sank in 1975, and that he was "about 80 years old," having been born in 1895. The Ground Truth Answer confirms that he was born in 1895 and was 80 years old in 1975 when the ship sank. The vital facts—birth year, age at the time of the sinking, and the fact that he was alive—are all present in the Predicted Answer. There is no loss of substantive information.
